resolve_model_catalog_url: resolve a model catalog URL by name using ModelCatalog.get to retrieve the S3 download URL
lookup_imagenet_pretrained_model: lookup an ImageNet pretrained model URL from ModelCatalog.C2_IMAGENET_MODELS mappings
get_detectron_baseline_url: get a Caffe2 Detectron baseline model URL from ModelCatalog.C2_DETECTRON_MODELS mappings
register_catalog_path_handler: register ModelCatalogHandler with PathManager to resolve catalog:// prefixed paths
open_catalog_model_file: open a model file from the catalog using catalog:// prefixed path via ModelCatalogHandler._open
